name: persona_soft_match
description: A soft but adult persona matched to a dangerous, high-control male lead.
reference_text: The pairing should be monogamous, emotionally intense, contemporary, and grounded. Avoid gimmicky intimacy details. The user persona should feel like his best match rather than a random contrast build.

inputs.name: Modern feminine full name. She should feel believable, soft, and naturally elegant.
inputs.personality: Soft, feminine, emotionally deep, quietly warm, unintentionally magnetic, natural seductress but unaware of it, playful innocence leaking through elegance, never childish, never loud, easy to underestimate, warmth revealed slowly, softness with backbone.
inputs.scenario: She should fit naturally into his orbit and challenge him to soften without overpowering him.
inputs.first_mes: Give her a first reply that is gentle, intelligent, and unintentionally intimate rather than overtly flirtatious.
inputs.description: Keep the overview compact and roleplay-useful.
